vocabulary.definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果
降低目标护甲
跟着单位持续影响周围单位；对友军或敌方都算，并记作用对象；固定在地上的区域归场地魔法
立刻重置冷却
攻击造成额外倍数伤害；有概率触发或强化下一次攻击都算
吸收一定伤害、按比例减少受到的伤害，或把受到的伤害延迟结算（如统帅朗姆酒、虚妄之诺）
目标无法普通攻击
降低或禁止目标的任何形式生命恢复，含属性回复；提升生命上限的效果不受影响
恢复生命值（治疗、生命恢复），含属性生命恢复（如治疗指环+4.5）
把目标变成无害小动物，期间无法攻击、施法和使用物品
使自身、队友、召唤物或复制体隐身
攻击或技能恢复自身生命：按造成的伤害、按目标生命或每次攻击固定值（攻击吸血、技能吸血、如噬魂鬼·盛宴、附魂面具）
降低目标魔抗，或让目标受到更多魔法或技能伤害
为自己恢复或从其他单位抽取法力（如莱恩法力吸取），含属性回蓝和回蓝倍率；对友军生效且能给自己回蓝的也算
目标无法使用物品
移动不受单位碰撞阻挡
目标无法移动；带ROOT_DISABLES字段的位移（所有闪烁类）也不能使用
闪烁、冲刺、跳跃、传送等主动改变自身位置
目标无法施放技能（仍可攻击、使用物品）
降低移动速度或攻击速度
提高技能造成的伤害
能摧毁树木

objects.subject: nullifier
objects.description_en: Active: Nullify  Dispels the target and applies a debuff for %mute_duration% seconds. Continuously dispels and slows the target.  Dispel Type:  Basic Dispel
notes_en: Can be cast on invulnerable units.

objects.subject: octarine_core
objects.description_en: Passive: Cooldown Reduction Reduces the cooldown time of all spells and items.

objects.subject: orb_of_corrosion
objects.description_en: Passive: Corrosion  Your attacks reduce the target's armor by %corruption_armor%, slows their movement by %slow_ranged%%% (%slow_melee%%% against melee targets), and reduces Health Restoration by %heal_reduction%%%. Lasts for %duration% seconds.
notes_en: Armor reduction does not stack with its components, Desolator, or Stygian Desolator.

objects.subject: orb_of_frost
objects.description_en: Passive: Frost Your attacks slow the target's movement by %slow_ranged%%% (%slow_melee%%% against melee targets), and reduces Health Restoration by %heal_reduction%%%. Lasts for %duration% seconds.

objects.subject: orchid
objects.description_en: Active: Soul Burn Silences the target unit for %silence_duration% seconds. At the end of the silence, %silence_damage_percent%%% of the damage received while silenced is inflicted as bonus magical damage.

objects.subject: overwhelming_blink
objects.description_en: Active: Overwhelming Blink  Teleport to a target point up to %blink_range% units away.  After teleportation, all enemies in a %radius% AoE take damage equal to %damage_base% + %damage_pct_instant%%% of your strength and an additional %damage_pct_over_time%%% over time, and have %movement_slow%%% movement speed slow and %attack_slow% attack speed slow for %duration% seconds.   Overwhelming Blink cannot be used for %blink_damage_cooldown% seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
notes_en: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.

objects.subject: pavise
objects.description_en: Active: Protect  When cast on an ally, grants them a physical damage barrier that absorbs %absorb_amount% damage. Duration: %duration%s.

objects.subject: phase_boots
objects.description_en: Active: Phase  Gives %phase_movement_speed%%% increased movement speed on melee heroes, and %phase_movement_speed_range%%% on ranged heroes, and lets you move through units and turn more quickly for %phase_duration% seconds. Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.

objects.subject: phylactery
objects.description_en: Passive: Empower Spell  The next Unit Target spell you cast on an enemy deals a separate %bonus_spell_damage% bonus damage to the target and slows them by %slow%%% for %slow_duration%s.

objects.subject: pipe
objects.description_en: Active: Barrier Gives a magic damage barrier that absorbs %barrier_block% damage to all nearby allies. Lasts %barrier_duration% seconds.  Radius: %barrier_radius%   Passive: Insight Aura  Gives allied units %magic_resistance_aura%%% magic resistance.  Radius: %aura_radius%
notes_en: Barrier does not affect units that have been affected by Barrier within Pipe of Insight's cooldown.
Stacks multiplicatively with other sources of magic resistance.

objects.subject: quelling_blade
objects.description_en: Active: Chop Tree  Destroy a target tree.     Passive: Quell  Increases attack damage against non-hero units by %damage_bonus% for melee heroes, and %damage_bonus_ranged% for ranged.
notes_en: Effects of multiple quelling blades do not stack.

objects.subject: radiance
objects.description_en: Toggle: Burn  When active, scorches enemies for %aura_damage% magical damage per second. Illusions deal %aura_damage_illusions% magical damage per second.  Radius: %aura_radius%

objects.subject: rapier
objects.description_en: Toggle: Transmute  Toggle to gain either %bonus_spell_amp%%% bonus spell amplification or %bonus_damage% bonus attack damage.   Passive: Everlasting   Dropped on death, and cannot be destroyed.    Becomes unusable if picked up by an ally of its owner until it is returned to its owner. It is immediately usable by anybody if an enemy of the owner picks it up and is killed. A dropped Rapier cannot be picked up by a courier.
notes_en: If Divine Rapier is dropped and picked up by an enemy of its original owner, it cannot be dropped again except by death.
Spell Amplification from multiple Rapiers does not stack.

objects.subject: refresher
objects.description_en: Active: Reset Cooldowns Resets the cooldowns of all your abilities. Shares a cooldown with Refresher Shard. This item's cooldown only progresses in your hero's main inventory.

objects.subject: refresher_shard
objects.description_en: Use: Reset Cooldowns Resets the cooldowns of all your abilities. Shares a cooldown with Refresher Orb. This item's cooldown only progresses in your hero's main inventory.

objects.subject: revenants_brooch
objects.description_en: Passive: Phantom Critical Grants each attack a %crit_chance%%% chance to deal an additional %crit_multiplier%%% of the attack's damage as bonus magic damage.
notes_en: Counts as a Critical Strike for purposes of stacking with other sources of Critical Strike.
Phantom Critical does not work against buildings.

objects.subject: ring_of_basilius
objects.description_en: Passive: Basilius Aura Grants %aura_mana_regen% mana regeneration to allies.    Radius: %aura_radius%

objects.subject: rod_of_atos
objects.description_en: Active: Cripple Roots the target for %duration% seconds.

objects.subject: satanic
objects.description_en: Active: Unholy Rage Increases Lifesteal percentage to %unholy_lifesteal_total_tooltip%%% for %unholy_duration% seconds.   Dispel Type:  Basic Dispel     Passive: Lifesteal Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.

objects.subject: shadow_amulet
objects.description_en: Active: Fade Grants invisibility to you or a target allied hero for %fade_duration%s. Movement speed during the invisibility is reduced by %movement_speed_reduction%%%.
notes_en: Takes %fade_time%s of the %fade_duration%s for the hero to fully fade into invisibility.

objects.subject: sheepstick
objects.description_en: Active: Hex Turns a target unit into a harmless critter for %sheep_duration% seconds. The target has a base movement speed of %sheep_movement_speed% and will be silenced, muted, and disarmed. Instantly destroys illusions.
notes_en: The target will have a base movement speed of %sheep_movement_speed%, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.

objects.subject: shivas_guard
objects.description_en: Active: Arctic Blast  Emits a freezing wave that deals %blast_damage% magical damage to enemies and slows their movement by %blast_movement_speed%%% for %blast_debuff_duration% seconds.  Radius: %blast_radius%   Passive: Freezing Aura  Reduces the attack speed of all enemies by %aura_attack_speed%.   Radius: %aura_radius%
notes_en: The wave extends at a speed of %blast_speed% to a max size of %blast_radius%.
The Arctic Blast follows its caster.
Multiple instances of Freezing Aura do not stack.
AoE bonuses from multiple Chasm Stones or its upgrades do not stack.
